name: Bitwarden
label: Bitwarden Public API + Secrets Manager
description: Bitwarden Public API (/public) + Secrets Manager REST via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://bitwarden.com/help/public-api/. Operations: list-collections, get-collection, update-collection, delete-collection, list-events, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, get-group-members, update-group-members, create-member, get-member, list-members, update-member, delete-member, get-member-groups, update-member-groups, get-secret, list-secrets, listen. Auth secret access_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). GET/access operations still call the official GET (or access) HTTP method. Retrieved secret material must not be logged and should stay in StudioQuack secret bindings (bind OUTPUT `data` into a secret; do not print it, persist it in engine variables, or leave it on a logged edge). listen is kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put access_token here. Path params match api_spec.json placeholders. Example: {"operation":"list-collections"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: list-collections | get-collection | update-collection | delete-collection | list-events | create-group | get-group | list-groups | update-group | delete-group | get-group-members | update-group-members | create-member | get-member | list-members | update-member | delete-member | get-member-groups | update-member-groups | get-secret | list-secrets | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen is ingress: no HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'list-collections'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Collection, group, member, or SM secret UUID depending on operation.

schema.label: organizationId
schema.description: Org UUID for list-secrets when not set in config.

schema.label: externalId
schema.description: Request-body parameter `externalId` for operations: update-collection, create-group, update-group, create-member, update-member.

schema.label: groups
schema.description: Request-body parameter `groups` for operations: update-collection, create-member.

schema.label: collections
schema.description: Request-body parameter `collections` for operations: create-group, update-group, create-member, update-member.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Request-body parameter `type` for operations: create-member, update-member.

schema.label: accessAll
schema.description: Request-body parameter `accessAll` for operations: create-member, update-member.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Secret bytes in data must not be logged; bind them into StudioQuack secrets. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON from the official API. May contain secret material — never log; bind into StudioQuack secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: list-collections, get-collection, update-collection, delete-collection, list-events, create-group, get-group, list-groups, update-group, delete-group, get-group-members, update-group-members, create-member, get-member, list-members, update-member, delete-member, get-member-groups, update-member-groups, get-secret, list-secrets, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Bearer for Public API (org token after client_credentials) or SM machine-account token. StudioQuack secret. Never logged. OfficialApiNode does not POST identity.bitwarden.com. Reject personal user.* keys.

configurationParameters.label: API host
configurationParameters.description: API host without scheme. Cloud US default api.bitwarden.com. EU: api.bitwarden.eu. Self-host: your.domain.com/api (path already includes /api).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon invoke budget (~300s).
